integrity: Proof is given by primitive conjugacy, valuation-layer determinant fibers, Smith invariants, and high-cone stratification. Complete finite enumerations corroborate but do not prove all cases.
scientific_limitations: Exact spectrum is for square-zero 2-by-2 matrices over finite commutative chain rings; the finite-field Jordan-type interpretation applies to the two-equal-block centralizer, not all nilpotents or higher matrix sizes. Independent validation and exhaustive priority examination are not performed.
title: Complete image-length spectra for square-zero matrices over finite chain rings
